annotations.title: Start an order at a lab

description: When the user has picked a lab and wants to book: checks the lab takes the test, quotes exactly what is paid online at checkout and what is paid at the lab, and returns the checkout link on herafertility.co with the lab and test already chosen. The user enters their own details and pays there; do not ask them for their name, date of birth, contact details or card. Pass the labRef from find_labs.

addDnaFragmentation.description: Add a sperm DNA fragmentation test to a semen analysis on the same order (one Hera fee). Only when the user asks for both.

labRef.description: The labRef returned by find_labs for the lab the user chose.
